packaging.value: The ground pickup spans the front of the base. Coral and algae mechanisms share an axis but have distinct contacts and drives. A central shoulder turns a four-stage elevator supported by an A-frame tied into the base; the carriage carries a compact differential wrist and two-piece end effector. High scoring therefore sweeps a volume above and across the base, while ground intake deployment occupies the front. The base uses different module clearances fore and aft. packaging.value: A circular bucket fills much of the square chassis between standard corner modules. A rotating capture assembly sits inside it and pushes fuel up a central tube to an inset turret. The turret hangs from structure above, keeping supports out of the approaching fuel stream; its yaw envelope consumes space that would otherwise store or guide fuel. The bucket splits into two pieces, and a removable rear panel provides battery access. Separate intake arms at the front deploy a sliding hopper. Internal bars protect the battery/module compartments, and rear bumper hardware carries serializer armor.
